_comment: Phase 0 of #338. What each compliance suite scored, so the workflow can
fail on a regression instead of never failing at all. Checked by
A floor, not a target. Raise it whenever the suites improve. Lowering one
is a deliberate act a reviewer should question.
Recorded from GitHub Actions run 36250029604 on 2026-09-26 (first run after the
gate landed), raised from run 36258702281 the same day once #345 gave the CI
stack an IdentityHub, an issuer identity and a seeded graph. These are the CI
ephemeral stack's numbers, which are NOT the same as a seeded local stack's.

dsp-tck-results.note: TIGHTENED 2026-10-28 to 25/0, run 40759615604 on chore/710-close-out (89f42662): 25 passed, 0 failed, 8 skipped. The one failure left, CAT-1.4, asked for a Federated Catalog API this connector build does not have (404, not in the management API spec); it now skips with that reason. RAISED 2026-10-28 from 21/6, runs 40708450227 and 40710803036 on fix/710-ci-dsp-path (2fc9539a, eb87d794): 25 passed, 1 failed, 7 skipped, twice. The six failures had one cause: CI created its participant contexts with no context config, so every DSP call answered 500 "No configuration found for participant context" before it left (#710, docs/gotchas.md 2026-10-28). A new seed step writes the STS config CFM writes locally, and the job now seeds the whole identity layer, so CAT-1.1 passes for alpha-klinik, pharmaco and medreg and CAT-1.3 passes. CAT-1.2 skips: the catalogue answers with no dataset, since the job seeds no assets. The 1 left is CAT-1.4, the federated catalogue request, not yet understood; hence the short review date. Earlier: LOWERED 2026-09-26 from 25/0 (run 36266621990), which was false: those checks passed on Jetty HTML error pages.

dcp-compliance-results.note: RAISED 2026-10-28 from 24/0, runs 40708450227 and 40710803036 on fix/710-ci-dsp-path: 27 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, twice. With a DSP path in CI (#710: the participant contexts now carry their STS config), TRUST-6.3 to 6.5 run instead of skipping: irs gets alpha-klinik's catalogue on the Simpl Governance Authority's credential, a MembershipCredential from the rogue issuer is refused with the control plane naming the issuer as untrusted, and after removing it irs is accepted again. Earlier: run 40688391687 (24/0) added TRUST-6.1 and 6.2; run 36267331316 raised it from 19/2. No review_by override: this floor is healthy, so the global date applies.

ehds-compliance-results.note: run 36259831503: 18 passed, 0 failed, 7 skipped, twice reproduced (fresh-DB proof and CI). bruno-api-results.note: RAISED 2026-10-28 from 178/1, run 40710803036 on eb87d794 (fix/710-ci-dsp-path): 179 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. The 1 that was left, `10 Connecting partner/16`, had two causes: it named the protocol dataspace-protocol-http:2025-1, for which no dispatcher is registered, and in CI the consumer's context had no STS config (#710). It now uses http-dsp-profile-2025-1 and the job seeds the config. A full house: any red is a real regression. Earlier: run 40654173116 on 872e578, 178/1, raised from 149/2 when the job started seeding neo4j/seed-study-results.cypher (ADR-059). Beware a neo4j-proxy readiness race: run 36418922439 scored 138/13 because every request proxied to port 9090 was refused while the proxy started.

bruno-api-azure-results.note: Demo Smoke run 40645836471 on cb1eb44: 153 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped over 153 against https://ehds.mabu.red. Raised from 123/0, which the collection had outgrown by 30 requests. Earlier history: run 36383527116 on ff2bba5: 123 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped over 123 against https://ehds.mabu.red. The live demo answers every request in the collection. ARMED 2026-09-28 at 122/1 and raised to 123/0 in the same change, once the dispatched run showed #373 closed: the entry the workflow comment asked for on the first run had never been committed, so for 100 consecutive runs the Bruno step failed on its own exit code while this gate printed NO BASELINE and passed. A full house is an unusual floor and a deliberate one: nothing here is known-broken any more, so any red is a real regression. Lower it only with a reason.
